Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util

Class BarCubeIdx

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.BarCubeIdx
public final class BarCubeIdx extends Object
Geometry and slot indexing shared by Bar Stack rendering, collision, ray targeting, and support.

A block contains eight layers of eight bars. Even layers run east-west, two bars across and four deep; odd layers run north-south, four across and two deep. Slots are indexed from the bottom layer upward and row by row within each layer.

A bar is supported when its footprint overlaps a bar in the layer below. This makes support cross between the alternating orientations instead of following fixed columns. At a block boundary, callers supply the lower block's top-layer occupancy as the supporting seam.

Bars do not rotate with the block; their orientation belongs to the layer.

  • Method Details

    • freshBlockSupports

      public static boolean freshBlockSupports(int index, @Nullable boolean[] seamBelow)
      Whether a prospective Bar Stack could support a bar at index. Since all of its slots are still empty, only the bottom layer can be supported. It is grounded when there is no Bar Stack below; otherwise its footprint must overlap seamBelow.

    • isGrounded

      public static boolean isGrounded(int index, SlotAccess handler, @Nullable boolean[] seamBelow)
      Whether a bar has support. Layers above the bottom consult the layer beneath them in the same block. The bottom layer consults seamBelow, the top-layer occupancy of the Bar Stack underneath. A null seam means there is no Bar Stack below, so the bottom layer is grounded.

    • isGroundedIn

      public static boolean isGroundedIn(boolean[] occupancy, int index, @Nullable boolean[] seamBelow)
      Applies isGrounded(int, com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.SlotAccess, boolean[]) to an occupancy snapshot rather than live slots. Settling and placement simulation use snapshots to evaluate a proposed state without mutating inventory.

    • seamSupports

      public static boolean seamSupports(int index, boolean[] seamBelow)
      Whether the top layer beneath a block overlaps the footprint of index. Layer 7 runs north-south and layer 0 east-west, so the alternating pattern continues across a block boundary and uses the same footprint test as support within a block.

    • traceAllPositions

      public static int traceAllPositions(ViewRay ray, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos blockPos)
      Finds the deposit target for a Bar Stack that does not yet exist and therefore has no occupied slots. Placement uses this to validate the initial deposit and its resulting collision shape before adding the block to the world.

    • traceAllPositions

      public static int traceAllPositions(ViewRay ray, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos blockPos, @Nullable SlotAccess handler)
      Finds the slot a deposit targets: the last empty slot along the view ray before the first occupied one, or the farthest intersected slot if the ray meets no occupied bar. A null handler describes a prospective, entirely empty block.

    • traceCubes

      public static int traceCubes(ViewRay ray, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos blockPos, BarStackBE be)
